items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Miroslav was in the band for a short while when we were – we played in Chicago

ctx.x: Did you have Miroslav Vitous in that band?

Miroslav was in the band for a short while when we were – we played in Chicago at the – I can’t think of that club. It’s non-existent any more. On – right on the lake, on [?Rocker] Drive, on the lake there. I mean on the river, right by the river.
Did somebody recruit him from you? Did you recruit him?
